sourceWindows: CURRENT / RESIDENT ADVISOR: https://ra.co/music — the live September 8, 2026 music index and its current album/EP windows were screened. Recent identities already retained in Runs 53–79 and release-only claims stayed below the ranked list.

CURRENT / BANDCAMP DAILY: https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic — the current index through August 7, 2026 and July electronic roundup were screened; previously mined July identities and pages without exact-track rhythmic or structural evidence were excluded.

ADJACENT / OPTIMO MUSIC: https://ra.co/reviews/23416 and https://bergsonist.bandcamp.com/track/planetary-systems — Heat's three tracks were screened. Bergsonist — Planetary Systems was retained from the exact review's syncopated-drum account and official identity/date.

ADJACENT / ASTRAL BLACK: https://ra.co/reviews/33838 and https://astralblack.bandcamp.com/album/planet-j — Planet J's four tracks were screened. Jossy Mitsu — Ø was retained from the exact review's slinky, shifting percussion and polyrhythmic-structure account.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / NORTHERN ELECTRONICS: https://ra.co/reviews/13218 and https://northernelectronics.bandcamp.com/track/licwiglunga — Misantropen's eight tracks were screened. Varg²™ — Licwiglunga was retained from the exact odd-meter drum-pattern description.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / OSTGUT TON: https://ra.co/reviews/5436 and https://shed030.bandcamp.com/track/another-wedged-chicken — Shedding The Past's ten tracks were screened. Shed — Another Wedged Chicken was retained from the exact measure-by-measure lurching-rhythm account.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / INFINITE MACHINE: https://ra.co/reviews/19147 and https://infinitemachine.bandcamp.com/album/im043-aphix-chemtrails-ep — Chemtrails' three tracks were screened. Aphix — 50 / Thrifty was retained from exact broken-rhythm, dub-stab and bit-crushed-drum descriptions.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Grey Area Volume Two, Varg's surrounding Northern Electronics catalogue, Skee Mask's Pool, Anna Kost's See Life Better and older Resident Advisor syncopation searches were screened. Already retained identities, compilation-only claims and results without exact-track structural evidence were excluded.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 43 named tracks and releases across current releases, adjacent and emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–79 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Current-release pages without exact-track rhythmic or structural evidence were retained only as scan context or excluded.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown. Attributed descriptions of metre, syncopation and rhythmic motion are evidence, not transition or flow verdicts.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Varg²™ — Licwiglunga: strongest explicit odd-meter construction from an overlooked Northern Electronics album.
2. Jossy Mitsu — Ø: strongest adjacent-world account of slinky, shifting percussion in a polyrhythmic structure.
3. Shed — Another Wedged Chicken: strongest measure-level lurching-rhythm account from overlooked catalogue.
4. Bergsonist — Planetary Systems: strongest abstract-techno/electro intersection, with syncopated drums documented by the exact review.
5. Aphix — 50 / Thrifty: strongest broken-beat and dub-techno hybrid lead from an overlooked Bristol-linked release.
